instruction: Extract the video frame at 00:25 and apply it as the background image for the tenth slide of the presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting a frame from landscape.mp4 at 00:25 and setting it as the background of slide 10 (index 9). Evaluator verifies: 1) slide 10 has a background image applied, and 2) the background image matches the video frame at 00:25 with at least 85% similarity using image correlation.

llm_judge_reasons: COMPLETE verification: Evaluator fully verifies both instruction requirements (extract frame at 00:25 AND apply as background)
Frame source verification: Getter extracts video frame at timestamp 25 seconds (lines 96-103 in impress.py) and compares with background image using cv2.matchTemplate correlation
Timestamp verification: Video frame is extracted at exactly timestamp=25 seconds as specified in config (line 100: cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, frame_number))
Similarity comparison: Background image from slide is compared with video frame using correlation coefficient, requiring 85% similarity (min_similarity=0.85)
Complete coverage: Both requirements verified - (1) correct frame extraction verified via image similarity, (2) background application verified via XML parsing + image comparison
Correct parameter handling: Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' (directly accesses expected.get('has_background'), expected.get('min_similarity'))
Proper state management: Postconfig saves file before getter reads .pptx, ensuring fresh state
Robust implementation: Proper error handling, file extraction via get_vm_file, standard cv2/PIL libraries
Minor note: matchTemplate with same-size images (line 120) returns 1x1 result accessed via [0][0] - unconventional but functionally correct for similarity scoring
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional improvement: Consider using cv2.compareHist or structural similarity (SSIM) instead of matchTemplate for same-size image comparison - more conventional approach
Optional improvement: Add dimension validation to ensure video frame and background image have compatible aspect ratios before resizing
